settings.description: U14 materialized: chroma-from-luma with a signalled per-channel gain. Each chroma AC coefficient becomes a residual against alpha times the luma coefficient at the same selection index, so the chroma scale field carries the residual scale instead of the raw one. The gains cost 2*cfl_bits prefix bits, which at tier 0 is two luma coefficients - the 'free' rows spend those bits anyway (larger hash) to separate 'does CfL predict anything' from 'does CfL pay for its signalling'.
